## 2. Core Research & Engineering Contributions

### Obelisk Proof Assistant (`MKTD1-system` & `MKTD2-system`)
- **Dual CakeML & Poly/ML Kernel Architecture**: Written in strict portable Standard ML (SML'97) so that the entire proof kernel, type checker, and theory exporters compile and execute identically under both Poly/ML and CakeML.
- **`MKTD1-system` (`MKTD1-framework` / `MKTD1-theory`)**: A sequent-calculus and typed-AST proof assistant for Morse-Kelley (MK) and von Neumann-Bernays-Goedel (NBG) class theory (`Class.Expression`, `Fm.Expression`, `Stmt.Expression`, `Ctx.Expression`, `Theory.Expression`, `Prf.Expression`). Includes 118 catalog entries (`1.1` through `5.21`) covering propositional/quantifier calculi, explicit capture-avoiding substitution hygiene (`FV`, `IFV`, `FFI`), Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pairs `(A, B)_D`, Kleene star tuple disjointness, decoupled semantic vs. syntactic completeness of full theories, and the complete machine-verified proof that every Grothendieck-Tarski universe $U$ satisfies $U = V_{U \cap \mathrm{On}}$ (`ThmUniverseEqVonNeumannStageInterOn`, Entry `3.90`).
- **`MKTD2-system` (`MKTD2-framework` / `MKTD2-theory`)**: A constructive dependent propositions-as-types proof assistant (`Π`, `Σ`, `λ`, dependent projections, propositional equality) featuring 225 mechanically type-checked records (202 derived constructive theorems, 16 conservative definitions, 7 irreducible MK/NBG axioms) spanning propositional/predicate logic, set/class algebra, ordinal arithmetic, category theory, Yoneda lemma, monads, kan extensions, ends/coends, 2-categories, and Grothendieck-Tarski cumulative hierarchy stages.
- **Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pairs**: Defines `(A, B)_D = {0 x x | x in A} U {1 x y | y in B}` so that ordered pairs, Cartesian products, and $n$-tuples operate uniformly on arbitrary proper classes and sets without collapsing when a component is a proper class (`A notin V`).
